declared-tag-missing: a declared tag key that OCI does not have, while the tags were read: authoritative absence, DRIFT
desired-absent: the dns label is not declared and OCI has none: it is not planned, there is no verdict entry
desired-absent-observed-present: DECISION CASE: the dns label is not declared and OCI has one: unmanaged, not planned, not drift; seen and listed as unmanaged
drift: the dns label and one tag value differ
empty-cidr-blocks: a successful answer with cidrBlocks [] : OCI requires one IPv4 block, so the empty list is not a trustworthy state: unknown, the raw [] is kept
extra-tag-full-set: the same extra tag under an explicit full-set tag supervision: it is in the scope, and an observed tag the intent does not carry is NOT_COMPARABLE in the engine (object DRIFT)
extra-tag-undeclared: OCI has a tag the intent does not declare; declared-keys scope: seen, unmanaged, not compared
field-absent: a wanted dns label that OCI does not report (not set): DRIFT, not 'unknown'
malformed-cidr: cidrBlocks is not a list: it was read but cannot be trusted: unknown
not-found: HTTP 404 NotAuthorizedOrNotFound: OCI does not tell 'deleted' from 'not allowed', so absence is NOT authoritative
partial-read: the answer has no ipv6CidrBlocks at all: ipv6_enabled was not observed, it is not 'false'
